programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.title: Ainsley's Festive Flavours
programme.desc: Ainsley Harriott throws open the kitchen doors and welcomes friends old and new for a Christmas feast. Actress and comedian Donna Preston pops in for a slice of mouth-watering tamarind, allspice and ginger glazed ham, with a juicy side of pineapple and rum relish, while actor Christopher Biggins joins for a taste of Ainsley's showstopping snow dome dessert, packed with festive flavours. Chef Phil Vickery lends a hand and offers up a party-friendly taste of the sea with his squid, prawn almond patties, and wine expert Jilly Goolden selects drinks for every occasion. Plus, music from classical star Alexis Ffrench

programme.title: John and Lisa's Christmas Kitchen
programme.desc: John Torode and Lisa Faulkner have got Christmas covered with classic dishes to serve up for the festive season, starting with sausages three ways and a trio of tempting glazes. The menu also includes a turkey crown with spiced roast root vegetables for a true centrepiece, two family recipes that John and Lisa cannot wait to share, and John's ultimate festive trifle, where he goes all out for a truly sensational pudding to share with family and friends

programme.title: Countess Dracula
programme.desc: Horror. Director: Peter Sasdy. Stars Ingrid Pitt, Nigel Green & Sandor Eles. Elderly widow Countess Elisabeth Nadasdy maintains her youthful appearance by bathing in the blood of virgins.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Before Caroline Munro closes tonights Cellar Club, listen to the horror that is in store for next week.

programme.title: The Fall of the House of Usher (1950)
programme.desc: 1950. Horror. A traveller arrives at Usher mansion to visit his friend Roderick (Kaye Tendeter) and discovers that Roderick and his sister (Gwen Watford) have been inflicted with a strange disease.

programme.title: Marked Men
programme.desc: 1940. Crime. Director: Sam Newfield. Stars Warren Hull, Isabel Jewell & Paul Bryar. A young medical-school graduate escapes prison and finds a small haven in Arizona until gangsters show up.

programme.title: St. Benny the Dip
programme.desc: 1951. Comedy. Directed by Edgar G. Ulmer. Stars Roland Young, Nina Foch & Dick Haymes. Three con artists unexpectedly wind up on the road to reformation while posing as priests to pull off a job.

programme.title: Soho Conspiracy
programme.desc: 1950. Drama. Restaurant owners' daughter Dora (Zena Marshall) and press agent Guy (John Witty) plan a concert to restore a bombed church, but their plans are thwarted by a lawyer who has other plans.

programme.title: Invasion
programme.desc: 1966. Fantasy. Director: Alan Bridges. Stars Edward Judd, Yoko Tani & Valerie Gearon. An English army unit come up against strange beings from another planet who have landed on earth.

programme.title: 12 Days of Christmas
programme.desc: Charming 1950s animation of the 12 days of Christmas. First aired in 1956 on Christmas eve.

programme.title: The Black Arrow
programme.desc: The Chess Game. 1973. Stars William Squire, Dorothea Phillips & Michael Ripper. The game continues as Sir Daniel recognises the pawns in his kingdom and Black Arrow continues his hunt.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: Ferocious Fathers. 1956. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. Lancelot goes to the rescue of Urgan the Strong, whose castle is besieged by Sir Melius the Mighty and his sons.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Joker's Epitaph. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. The Joker is now Vice Chairman of the Gotham National Bank, due to an unsuccessful plan of Batman's.

programme.title: The Roy Rogers Show
programme.desc: Carnival Killer. 1952. Stars Roy Rogers, Pat Brady & Dale Evans. Roy, Dale and Pat help investigate the murder of a carnival owner.

programme.title: Stingray
programme.desc: Loch Ness Monster. 1964. Stars Ray Barrett, Robert Euston & David Graham. When Commander Shore's friend claims to have seen the Loch Ness Monster, the Stingray crew is sent to investigate.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Prisoner. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard, Jennifer Jayne & Michael Caine. On his way to deliver a message to William Tell, a resistance man is captured and taken to a fortress.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: The Raiders. 1956. Stars Alec Clunes, Jane Griffiths & Peter Hammond. New Providence is in danger from pirate raiders led by Charles Vane, leaving Governor Rogers to face a tough decision.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Will Scarlet. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. Garishly dressed William Winchester is at the inn Robin and Little John go to, swords are drawn as John insults Will.

programme.title: Battle Beyond The Sun
programme.desc: 1962. Sci-fi. Directed by Mikhail Karyukov, Aleksandr Kozyr & Francis Ford Coppola. Stars Edd Perry & Arla Powell. In the distant future, two rival nations race to be the first to land on Mars.

programme.title: The Atomic Submarine
programme.desc: 1959. Sci-fi. Directed by Spencer Gordon Bennet. Stars Arthur Franz & Dick Foran. A submarine is sent out to investigate a series of naval disasters, but the crew also get caught up in the chaos.

programme.title: The Love Match
programme.desc: Comedy. Director: David Paltenghi. Stars Arthur Askey, Glenn Melvyn & Thora Hird. Two football loving railway workers get into trouble after racing their engine home to get to a match on time.

programme.title: The League of Gentlemen
programme.desc: 1960. Crime Drama. Director: Basil Dearden. Stars Jack Hawkins, Richard Attenborough, Nigel Patrick & Roger Livesey. Ex-army men are recruited for a bank robbery that requires military precision.

programme.title: Christmas In Britain - Glimpses
programme.desc: Join the festive cheer all over the country in this short film showing how Christmases past were celebrated in London, the great British countryside and a traditional British home.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: Voices From The Past. 1962. Stars Rupert Davies, Victor Lucas & Fay Compton. Maigret is thrown into a world where he must tread delicately when investigating the violent death of Count St Hilaire.

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: Breaking Point. 1971. Directed by Gerry Mill. Stars Colin Douglas, Barbara Flynn & Coral Atkins. The iconic seventies drama series continues with the third and final series. (S3, E12)

programme.title: The Proposition
programme.desc: Drama. Director: John Hillcoat. Stars John Hurt, Guy Pearce & Ray Winstone. A lawman gives an outlaw nine days to kill his older brother, or they'll execute his younger brother.

programme.title: Crime Story
programme.desc: All Good Friends: The Case of the Handless Corpse. 1992. Stars Suzanne Packer & Michelle Chadwick. Based on the 1979 case, where two divers found the body of a man in a flooded Lancashire quarry.

programme.title: EuroTrash
